scope: Prepare a separately identified CMB+DESI BAO+official Pantheon+SH0ES absolute-calibration target. No inference, CAMB/background evaluation or numerical posterior is authorized by this preparation stage.
SN_interface: Consume the independently audited ReleasedCalibration interface with the official retained1657 measurements and complete selected covariance. Calibrator rows use released CEPH_DIST, noncalibrators use CAMB angular-diameter distances with the released heliocentric/cosmological redshift convention. Do not infer original frozen-ladder row identities from matching counts.
normalization: Integrate the single common SN absolute magnitude with the same flat-M measure, retaining the full covariance determinant and intercept information. No proper evidence normalization is claimed for an improper M prior.
no_double_counting: This sample REPLACES Dovekie. Do not add a separate H0 Gaussian, the newly compressed37-host Cepheid factor, geometric-anchor likelihood, or another overlapping SN sample. Cepheid covariance is already in this released anchored product.
fixed_physics: Build the unchanged modern_fast configuration and replace only released_sn. Preserve every CMB/BAO likelihood, normalized sampled prior, fixed nuisance coordinate, neutrino/flatness setting and CAMB physical-domain restriction. Epsilon remains fixed0. Luminosity-prior extensions are outside this design.
numerical_proposal: Optional existing CPU SpectralSurrogate configuration is a numerical proposal only. It receives an independent anchored target identity and would require a new, explicitly routed native-CAMB correction; Dovekie proposal performance or convergence does not qualify this alternative.
identity: Verify the released anchored table/covariance/interface source and current actual CMB/BAO likelihood assets and package versions. Record input ordering, calibrator mask, release/calibration lineage, every new source hash and optional surrogate hash. Refuse a stale calibration validation record.
driver: Fresh-only immutable preparation manifest/configuration. This stage offers no sampling, logposterior or background command. Existing unanchored driver/correction/report entrypoints are explicitly incompatible because their factory and sample dispatch are closed over original sample names/classes.
validation: Compare canonical LCDM/CPL configurations with the original target after removing only released_sn; every other key and prior must be identical. Validate native and optional-surrogate routing, anchored metadata and sample identity, reject changed input/source/lineage fixtures, and enforce no model-construction or CAMB call during preparation. A separate source audit validates the SN likelihood algebra/covariance; this wrapper does not replace it.
integration_limit: A future sampling/correction/consumer adapter must explicitly route this class and anchored sample and preserve numerical gates. Free-M integration now leaves absolute H0 information through calibrator versus Hubble-flow rows; unanchored free-offset distance conveniences cannot be silently reused. This alternative is conditional on the released distance ladder/calibration/selection model and assumed cross-probe factorization.
